# PACK&GO regional prototype maps

Generated by `scripts/generate-region-maps.mjs` from the self-hosted jsVectorMap 1.7.0 world map in `assets/vendor/jsvectormap/world.js`. The runtime and bundled map source are retained with the jsVectorMap MIT license at `assets/vendor/jsvectormap/LICENSE`.

The generated assets are local design-prototype basemaps. They contain no tiles, API keys, tracking, or live map service. Route points use the same Miller projection declared by the source map.
